description: Report that you finished handling a trigger fire (a message that starts with [self-starter]). Call it once per fire, at the end, with the fire_id from the message, one line on what you found or did, and notify=true only if the user should be told now.

fire_id.description: The fire id from the [self-starter] message, such as fire_...

notify.description: true if the user should get a notification now.

summary.description: One line for the user: what you found or did.

name: trigger_report
